items.title: New Handheld Robotic Technology Powers Knee Surgery At Thomson Hospital
items.summary: Handheld, robotic-assisted technology at Thomson Hospital Kota Damansara for minimally invasive total knee replacement supports a more comfortable path to recovery. The robotic system gives surgeons insight into each patient's individual knee anatomy. The post New Handheld Robotic Technology Powers Knee Surgery At Thomson Hospital appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: State Government Can Address Doctor No-Shows If Sabah Gets 40% Revenue: Masidi
items.summary: Sabah DCM Masidi Manjun says staff accommodation and remuneration of doctors are the federal government's financial and constitutional responsibility, but says the state government can do much more if Sabah gets its constitutional 40% revenue entitlement. The post State Government Can Address Doctor No-Shows If Sabah Gets 40% Revenue: Masidi appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Allocate Borneo Medical Service Package In Budget 2027 — Dr James Jeremiah
items.summary: The federal Budget 2027 should fund a Borneo Medical Service Package to attract doctors to serve in Sabah and Sarawak. Both state governments should also allocate funding for state allowances or bonuses and to improve staff accommodation for doctors. The post Allocate Borneo Medical Service Package In Budget 2027 — Dr James Jeremiah appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Borneo No-Shows: Doctors Today Have Other Choices — Physician
items.summary: If Sabah and Sarawak want to attract doctors, make them want to come. The state governments should top up their federal basic salaries by 30% to 40%, besides providing Cola/housing/regional allowances at RM6,000 a month. Fund three return flights yearly. The post Borneo No-Shows: Doctors Today Have Other Choices — Physician appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: A Public Health Doctor Isn’t An ‘Office Doctor’ — Dr MFH
items.summary: Public Health Medicine is sometimes misunderstood as admin work. But the office is only one working base. The medicine happens across communities, clinics, hospitals, laboratories, workplaces, schools and other agencies. TB shows the difference clearly. items.title: MMA Sabah: Only 34% Of Medical Officers Showed Up For Hospital Postings
items.summary: MMA Sabah says only 34% of medical officers from outside Sabah posted to hospitals in the state had reported for duty (47 out of 138). If this 66% no-show rate persists till Oct 7, it will exceed the deputy health minister's earlier 50% no-show projection. The post MMA Sabah: Only 34% Of Medical Officers Showed Up For Hospital Postings appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Report For Duty By Oct 7, MOH Urges Doctors Amid Early No-Shows
items.summary: MOH urges medical officers to report for duty at their new placements by Oct 7, saying the process is still ongoing and that people shouldn't draw any "premature conclusions" yet. The second phase of permanent appointments this year involves 4,255 doctors. The post Report For Duty By Oct 7, MOH Urges Doctors Amid Early No-Shows appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: What I Owe The Next Houseman — Dr Kamal Amzan
items.summary: Housemen need supervisors who know their progress, are available when decisions exceed their competence, and can explain what improvement looks like. Those supervisors need time and support too. The post What I Owe The Next Houseman — Dr Kamal Amzan appeared first on CodeBlue .
